hero:
Use case: ui-mockup. Combine the TWO attached SCENE design references into ONE cohesive NEW desktop website hero. Image1 supplies tactile ivory paper note, hand-drawn coral arrows and creative collage personality. Image2 supplies vivid full-bleed cobalt #2D4BFF background, enormous warm-white type and one cinematic landscape frame. This is not a collage of two screenshots; design one coherent buildable web page, landscape16:10 around1440x900, straight-on, no browser frame or devices. Header: warm-white SCENE upper left, plain Russian nav «Процесс», «Примеры», «Попробовать» right. Main two-line HUGE geometric grotesk headline centered upper half, exact text «Дай идее
движение.» warm ivory #F4F0E9, bold confident tight tracking, readable and spacious, 120px-ish. Below headline ONE large wide cinematic frame, centered, width72percent, height32percent of viewport: photorealistic coral-jacketed traveler with cream backpack on pale sculptural Mediterranean cliffs above blue sea. White fine 9:16 crop guides select traveler in center; simple corner viewfinder brackets and minimal small «00:05 / 00:15» time label. A SINGLE beautiful tactile TORN IVORY PAPER NOTE from reference1 overlaps the LOWER RIGHT OUTER CORNER of this frame, rotated 7degrees clockwise, with natural paper texture and subtle realistic shadow. Note must not hide traveler or page CTA. On note large cobalt handwritten/editorial type reads EXACT «Показать
приложение
за 15 секунд.» and below it simple navy hand-drawn rectangular video screen with tiny play triangle and timeline. Use live-HTML-friendly note text, not illegible marks. One elegant CORAL hand-drawn curved arrow arcs from right side of headline toward this note, and a second smaller coral curved arrow from lower-left frame edge points toward main CTA. The two arrows feel drawn by a creative director, not random scribbles. Below frame at left-of-center, concise warm-white supporting copy «От первой мысли до истории,
которую хочется досмотреть.» Beside/below it a coral rectangular CTA «Собрать свою историю ↗» dark navy text, comfortably visible above bottom edge. Small unboxed footer note «15 секунд. Три сцены. Твой ритм.» Keep note modest at about19percent screen width, not a second dominant headline. Preserve useful blue negative space, clean reading zones, physical collage depth inside otherwise flat bold identity. Palette only cobalt, ivory, coral and navy; no black/lime, no gradients, no app dashboard, no pills, no fake numbers, no extra scattered photos, no fake customers. All important content fits a first laptop viewport; this is one production-friendly visual direction, large readable Cyrillic, faithful combination of the selected elements, playful cinematic creative studio aesthetic.
